sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首了，体内血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来凶手煞费苦心来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫简·多伊。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是“罪案档案呈现”推出的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: Our episodes deal with serious and often distressing incidents.
sentences.zh: 我们的节目涉及严重且通常令人痛心的事件。

sentences.en: If you feel at any time you need support, please contact your local crisis centre.
sentences.zh: 如果您在任何时候感到需要帮助，请联系您当地的危机干预中心。

sentences.en: For suggested phone numbers for confidential support, please see the show notes for this episode on your app, or on our website.
sentences.zh: 有关保密支持的建议电话号码，请查看您应用程序上或我们网站上的本集节目说明。

sentences.en: In April 1977, Bev Roberts was anxiously awaiting the Easter long weekend.
sentences.zh: 1977年4月，贝v·罗伯茨正焦急地期盼着复活节长周末。

sentences.en: Her younger brother, Russell Martin, had abruptly left town earlier that year, leaving behind his wife and four young children.
sentences.zh: 她的弟弟罗素·马丁于当年早些时候突然离开小镇，留下了他的妻子和四个年幼的孩子。

sentences.en: It wasn't out of character for Russell to take off from time to time, but he always kept in touch.
sentences.zh: 罗素偶尔离开并不是什么稀奇事，但他总是保持联系。

sentences.en: This time, no one had heard from him.
sentences.zh: 这一次，谁也没有他的消息。

sentences.en: Russell was born and raised in the small, regional town of Stahl in Victoria's weSt.
sentences.zh: 罗素出生并在维多利亚州西部的小城镇斯塔尔长大。

sentences.en: Stahl meant a lot to the 31-year-old.
sentences.zh: 斯塔尔对这个31岁的年轻人意义重大。

sentences.en: The heritage gold rush era township prospered during the 1850s mining boom, attracting a population of more than 30,000 people.
sentences.zh: 这个拥有淘金热历史的城镇在1850年代的采矿热潮中繁荣起来，吸引了超过3万人口。

sentences.en: When the yields were no longer commercially viable by the mid-1920s, the population began to dwindle.
sentences.zh: 到了1920年代中期，当产量不再具有商业价值时，人口开始减少。

sentences.en: Those who remained were small-town families, farmers and retirees, those who preferred a quiet way of life among a close-knit community.
sentences.zh: 留下来的是小镇家庭、农民和退休人员，他们更喜欢在紧密团结的社区中过平静的生活。

sentences.en: By the 1970s, the population of Stahl was around 6,000 residents, many of whom struggled to find steady employment.
sentences.zh: 到了1970年代，斯塔尔的人口约为6000名居民，其中许多人很难找到稳定的工作。

sentences.en: Most of the manufacturing industries had closed and the railway depot had been relocated, leaving few job opportunities.
sentences.zh: 大多数制造业已经倒闭，铁路 depot 也已搬迁，几乎没有就业机会。

sentences.en: The town relied heavily on tourism and hospitality, an industry serviced by the town's proximity to the sprawling, forest-covered mountain ranges of the Grampians National Park.
sentences.zh: 该镇严重依赖旅游业和酒店业，这一行业得益于该镇靠近格兰屏国家公园绵延起伏的森林山脉的地理位置。

sentences.en: It was the landscape and lifestyle Stahl offered that kept Russell Martin from leaving town for good.
sentences.zh: 正是斯塔尔提供的风景和生活方式让罗素·马丁没有永远离开这个小镇。

sentences.en: His social life revolved around the local pubs and footy club, where he was known by his mates as Stabber, and would delight crowds with his piano accordion.
sentences.zh: 他的社交生活围绕着当地的酒吧和澳式足球俱乐部展开，他的朋友们叫他“刺客”，他常常用钢琴手风琴取悦人群。

sentences.en: No matter where he went or why, Russell's journey always led him back home.
sentences.zh: 无论他去哪里，无论出于什么原因，罗素的旅程总是引导他回到家中。

sentences.en: Bev was hoping Russell would return for the biggest event on the town's calendar, the Stahl Gift.
sentences.zh: 贝v希望罗素能回来参加镇上日程表上最大的活动——斯塔尔礼品赛。

sentences.en: Occurring over the Easter long weekend, the Stahl Gift is the oldest and richest short-distance foot race in Australia.
sentences.zh: 斯塔尔礼品赛在复活节长周末举行，是澳大利亚历史最悠久、奖金最高短跑比赛。

sentences.en: It draws in large crowds of participants, supporters and punters from across the country and further afield.
sentences.zh: 它吸引了来自全国各地及更远地区的广大参赛者、支持者和赌客。

sentences.en: Russell Martin always looked forward to the gift.
sentences.zh: 罗素·马丁总是期盼着这项赛事。

sentences.en: Bev knew that if her brother didn't turn up to place a bet on the races, something was terribly wrong.
sentences.zh: 贝v知道，如果她的弟弟没有出现去为比赛下注，那就一定是出了大问题。

sentences.en: The 1977 Stahl Gift came and went with no sign of Russell Martin.
sentences.zh: 1977年的斯塔尔礼品赛来了又去，却不见罗素·马丁的踪影。

sentences.en: On May 3, Bev and her mother Ellen visited the local police station to file a missing persons report.
sentences.zh: 5月3日，贝v和她的母亲埃伦前往当地警察局报案失踪。

sentences.en: It had been three and a half months since Russell left town unexpectedly without offering a good buy.
sentences.zh: 自从罗素没有告别就意外离开小镇以来，已经过去三个半月了。

sentences.en: Bev and Ellen knew better than most that Russell was not a perfect person.
sentences.zh: 贝v和埃伦比大多数人更清楚罗素并不是一个完美的人。

sentences.en: He had his vices, mainly drinking and gambling, and was hot-headed and prone to violence.
sentences.zh: 他有缺点，主要是喝酒和赌博，而且脾气火爆，容易冲动行事。

sentences.en: But he loved his children.
sentences.zh: 但他爱他的孩子们。

sentences.en: Whenever he was out of town,
sentences.zh: 每当他离开镇子时，

sentences.en: Russell would at the very least keep in touch with his kids.
sentences.zh: 罗素至少会与他的孩子们保持联系。

sentences.en: Yet, they hadn't heard from him.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们一直没有他的消息。

sentences.en: Knowing her son's temperament,
sentences.zh: 了解儿子的脾气，

sentences.en: Ellen feared that Russell would cause harm if he returned to town.
sentences.zh: 埃伦担心罗素如果回到镇上会惹出祸端。

sentences.en: He would be incensed to find out that his wife, Helen, had moved another man into their marital home.
sentences.zh: 如果他发现妻子海伦把另一个男人搬进了他们的婚姻住宅，他一定会怒不可遏。

sentences.en: Russell and Helen's relationship dated back to when they were teenagers.
sentences.zh: 罗素和海伦的关系可以追溯到他们十几岁的时候。

sentences.en: Russell's siblings disapproved of the pairing from the outset.
sentences.zh: 罗素的兄弟姐妹从一开始就不赞成这段感情。

sentences.en: Helen Wilcock had a reputation as a wild child, and Russell was possessive and prone to jealousy.
sentences.zh: 海伦·威尔科克有着“野孩子”的名声，而罗素占有欲强且容易嫉妒。

sentences.en: They advised against the couple marrying, but Russell and Helen went ahead with the ceremony.
sentences.zh: 他们建议两人不要结婚，但罗素和海伦还是举行了婚礼。

sentences.en: In 1964, they became Mr. and Mrs. Martin.
sentences.zh: 1964年，他们成为了马丁夫妇。

sentences.en: Both were 19 years old.
sentences.zh: 两人当时都是19岁。

sentences.en: They had four children and eventually settled into a three-bedroom weatherboard house on Ligar Street, not far from the main street of Storr.
sentences.zh: 他们有了四个孩子，最终在斯托尔主街不远的利加街定居在一栋三居室的木板房里。

sentences.en: Their daughters, Lee and Kelly, shared one room.
sentences.zh: 他们的女儿莉和凯利共用一个房间。

sentences.en: Their sons, Stephen and Paul, shared the second.
sentences.zh: 他们的儿子斯蒂芬和保罗共用第二个房间。

sentences.en: Russell and Helen had the third.
sentences.zh: 罗素和海伦拥有第三个房间。

sentences.en: It wasn't an idyllic marriage.
sentences.zh: 这不是一段田园诗般的婚姻。

sentences.en: Russell and Helen were products of disadvantaged backgrounds and it influenced their treatment of one another.
sentences.zh: 罗素和海伦都出身于弱势背景，这影响了他们彼此对待的方式。

sentences.en: Russell was the sixth of seven children, born on July 10, 1945.
sentences.zh: 罗素是七个孩子中的老六，出生于1945年7月10日。

sentences.en: His parents, Michael and Ellen, were problem drinkers.
sentences.zh: 他的父母迈克尔和埃伦都是问题饮酒者。

sentences.en: They would often stay out all night until they'd spent all their money or were escorted home by police.
sentences.zh: 他们经常在外面待上一整夜，直到花光所有的钱，或者被警察护送回家。

sentences.en: Some of their drinking binges lasted weeks.
sentences.zh: 他们有些酗酒狂欢持续了数周之久。

sentences.en: They fought loudly and frequently over their many problems, including Ellen's flagrant infidelity.
sentences.zh: 他们经常为许多问题大声争吵，包括埃伦明目张胆的不忠。

sentences.en: Throughout his childhood,
sentences.zh: 在他的整个童年时期，

sentences.en: Russell was at the centre of a rumour regarding the identity of his biological father.
sentences.zh: 罗素一直是关于他亲生父亲身份谣言的中心。

sentences.en: He was also bullied for being the child of the town drunks, as well as for his poor hygiene and academic struggles.
sentences.zh: 他还因为是镇上酒鬼的孩子以及卫生状况差和学业困难而受到欺负。

sentences.en: The Martin children were severely neglected by their parents.
sentences.zh: 马丁家的孩子们受到了父母的严重虐待。

sentences.en: Child protection officers visited the household, but the children would hide in the nearby forest to avoid them.
sentences.zh: 儿童保护官员曾造访过这个家庭，但孩子们会躲在附近的森林里避开他们。

sentences.en: Sometimes they'd sleep out there for days at a time and arrive at school dirty and unkempt.
sentences.zh: 有时他们会在那里睡上好几天，到学校时又脏又邋遢。

sentences.en: Russell was teased for having burrs stuck in his knotty hair.
sentences.zh: 罗素因为头发打结沾满了苍耳而遭到嘲笑。

sentences.en: He would try to remove them himself, but the results were disastrous and only caused more ridicule.
sentences.zh: 他会试图自己拔掉它们，但结果往往很糟糕，反而引来更多嘲笑。

sentences.en: Russell learned to retaliate with his fists and became known as a fierce fighter who wasn't afraid of anyone.
sentences.zh: 罗素学会了用拳头进行报复，并成为了一个不怕任何人的强悍战士。

sentences.en: Helen had experienced her husband's violence first hand.
sentences.zh: 海伦亲身体验过她丈夫的暴力。

sentences.en: Police officers attended domestic disputes at the couple's house sometimes as often as once a month.
sentences.zh: 警察有时一个月一次来到这对夫妇的家中处理家庭纠纷。

sentences.en: But charges were rarely laid.
sentences.zh: 但很少有人被起诉。

sentences.en: Helen felt sorry for Russell.
sentences.zh: 海伦为罗素感到难过。

sentences.en: She believed he only acted the way he did because of his upbringing, which had caused him to hate women.
sentences.zh: 她相信他之所以有这样的表现，完全是因为他的成长经历，这导致他痛恨女性。

sentences.en: When reporting her son missing,
sentences.zh: 在报告儿子失踪时，

sentences.en: Ellen Martin expressed concern for Helen in particular.
sentences.zh: 埃伦·马丁特别表达了对海伦的担忧。

sentences.en: She feared that Russell would harm his wife if he found out she had moved on with another man.
sentences.zh: 她担心罗素如果发现妻子已经和另一个男人在一起，会伤害她。

sentences.en: Ellen said that the only way Helen would have a new boyfriend was if she knew for sure that Russell was never coming back.
sentences.zh: 埃伦说，海伦能有新男友的唯一前提是她确信罗素永远不会回来了。

sentences.en: Russell's sister, Bev, felt Helen had been behaving suspiciously since January.
sentences.zh: 罗素的姐姐贝v觉得海伦自1月以来表现得很可疑。

sentences.en: For new years,
sentences.zh: 新年期间，

sentences.en: Russell and Helen took their children on a lakeside camping trip
sentences.zh: 罗素和海伦带着孩子进行了一次湖畔露营旅行

sentences.en: 160 kilometres west of Stahl.
sentences.zh: 位于斯塔尔以西160公里处。

sentences.en: It was the couple's first holiday together in their 13-year relationship.
sentences.zh: 这是这对夫妇13年恋爱关系中的第一次度假。

sentences.en: Bev tagged along for the first few days of the trip.
sentences.zh: 贝v在旅行的前几天也跟着去了。

sentences.en: On several occasions,
sentences.zh: 在好几次场合中，

sentences.en: Helen left the campsite without good explanation.
sentences.zh: 海伦没有给出合理解释就离开了露营地。

sentences.en: The Martins returned to Stahl around January 13 and Russell continued his woodcutting business.
sentences.zh: 马丁一家在1月13日左右返回斯塔尔，罗素继续他的伐木生意。

sentences.en: He spent the next few days chopping up some wood so he could sell it.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几天里，他一直在劈柴以便出售。

sentences.en: Then, on Tuesday January 25,
sentences.zh: 然后，在1月25日星期二，

sentences.en: Helen visited Bev.
sentences.zh: 海伦拜访了贝v。

sentences.en: She asked if Bev could deliver the wood to one of Russell's customers.
sentences.zh: 她问贝v是否可以把木材送到罗素的一位客户那里。

sentences.en: It was a strange requeSt.
sentences.zh: 这是一个奇怪的要求。

sentences.en: Bev wondered why her brother had gone to the effort to prepare the wood, only to not follow through with its sale.
sentences.zh: 贝v纳闷，为什么她的弟弟费尽心思准备了木头，却又不完成销售。

sentences.en: According to Helen,
sentences.zh: 据海伦说，

sentences.en: Russell had spent Tuesday January 18 in bed.
sentences.zh: 罗素在1月18日星期二一整天都躺在床上。

sentences.en: At 11.10pm, he asked her for the time and date.
sentences.zh: 晚上11点10分，他问她时间和日期。

sentences.en: When Helen answered, he got up and said he had to go out for a minute.
sentences.zh: 当海伦回答后，他起身说他必须出去一会儿。

sentences.en: He returned at 1.20am to pick up some clothing, his toothbrush and toothpaste.
sentences.zh: 他在凌晨1点20分回来拿了一些衣服、牙刷和牙膏。

sentences.en: He placed $100 cash on the bench along with the new watch that Helen had given him for Christmas.
sentences.zh: 他在长凳上放了100美元现金以及海伦圣诞节送给他的新表。

sentences.en: He told her to sell it and anything else she needed.
sentences.zh: 他让她把它卖掉，并卖掉任何她需要的其他东西。

sentences.en: Russell then apparently said,
sentences.zh: 显然罗素随后说道，

sentences.en: I can never come back to Stahl again.
sentences.zh: 我再也不能回斯塔尔了。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉。

sentences.en: I'm glad we had the holiday.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴我们有过这次假期。

sentences.en: He told Helen to prepare herself for a couple of shocks and then walked out the front door.
sentences.zh: 他告诉海伦做好面对几次打击的准备，然后走出了前门。

sentences.en: Helen ran to the window and saw the back end of what looked like a white wagon or panel van.
sentences.zh: 海伦跑向窗户，看到了一辆看起来像白色旅行车或厢式货车的后部。

sentences.en: Russell got into the passenger seat and the car took off.
sentences.zh: 罗素坐上了副驾驶座，车子开走了。

sentences.en: Helen begged Bev not to tell anybody.
sentences.zh: 海伦恳求贝v不要告诉任何人。

sentences.en: She said it was likely that Russell had just been drunk and would be back soon.
sentences.zh: 她说罗素可能只是喝醉了，很快就会回来。

sentences.en: She wanted to avoid the humiliation of people knowing he had left her again.
sentences.zh: 她想避免让别人知道他又抛弃她的屈辱。

sentences.en: Russell had previously had an affair that resulted in a child.
sentences.zh: 罗素以前有过一段导致生下一个孩子的婚外情。

sentences.en: During that time, he periodically went back and forth between both women until his lover moved away.
sentences.zh: 在那期间，他在两个女人之间来回摇摆，直到他的情人搬走。

sentences.en: Bev knew Russell could take off for several days or weeks at a time, so Helen's story sounded plausible enough.
sentences.zh: 贝v知道罗素可以一走了之好几天甚至几周，所以海伦的故事听起来还算合情合理。

sentences.en: She did think it was strange that he left while nursing a broken ankle.
sentences.zh: 她确实觉得奇怪的是，他脚踝骨折还没好就离开了。

sentences.en: In fact, she was certain he was still relying on crutches to get around.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她确信他出行仍然依靠拐杖。

sentences.en: She couldn't imagine why or how he would go travelling in such a condition.
sentences.zh: 她无法想象在那种状况下他怎么会去旅行，又为什么要旅行。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, she figured he would be back soon as he couldn't stand to be away from his children for long.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，她还是觉得他很快就会回来，因为他忍受不了离开孩子太久。

sentences.en: A few days later,
sentences.zh: 几天后，

sentences.en: Bev and Helen spoke again.
sentences.zh: 贝v和海伦又谈了话。

sentences.en: On this occasion,
sentences.zh: 这一次，

sentences.en: Helen said she had been mistaken about the date that Russell left.
sentences.zh: 海伦说她记错了罗素离开的日期。

sentences.en: It had been the previous Thursday, not the Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 那是上周四，而不是星期二。

sentences.en: She then broke down in tears, telling Bev that some money had gone missing from the Glenorchy Football Club and she believed Russell had taken it.
sentences.zh: 她随后崩溃大哭，告诉贝v格伦奥奇足球俱乐部的一些钱不见了，她相信是罗素拿的。

sentences.en: He had played for the club before it folded due to poor performance and low player numbers.
sentences.zh: 他在该俱乐部由于表现不佳和球员人数不足而解散之前曾为其效力。

sentences.en: When the club's accounts were finalised, only a small amount of money remained in the treasury.
sentences.zh: 当俱乐部的账目结清时，金库里只剩下少量的钱。

sentences.en: It was obvious that someone appropriated what little funds had been in there.
sentences.zh: 很明显有人侵占了里面仅存的资金。

sentences.en: Helen Martin immediately fell under suspicion.
sentences.zh: 海伦·马丁立刻受到了怀疑。

sentences.en: She was the club's secretary and treasurer and was responsible for taking the money to be banked each week.
sentences.zh: 她是俱乐部的秘书兼财务，负责每周将钱存入银行。

sentences.en: Meetings were held to determine what happened to the missing money.
sentences.zh: 举行了会议以确定失踪的钱去了哪里。

sentences.en: But each time,
sentences.zh: 但每一次，

sentences.en: Helen provided an excuse as to why she couldn't attend.
sentences.zh: 海伦都借口无法出席。

sentences.en: Helen claimed it was Russell who took the club's money.
sentences.zh: 海伦声称是罗素拿了俱乐部的钱。

sentences.en: She said he used it to gamble and promised to return it from his winnings or the following week's earnings.
sentences.zh: 她说他用这些钱去赌博，并承诺用他的赢彩金或第二周的收入来归还。

sentences.en: Helen always gave her husband the money to avoid conflict and because he would take it anyway.
sentences.zh: 海伦总是把钱给她丈夫以避免冲突，而且因为他横竖都会拿走。

sentences.en: In the end, he borrowed more than he repaid.
sentences.zh: 最后，他借的钱比还的还要多。

sentences.en: By season's end, there was almost no money in the club's bank account.
sentences.zh: 到赛季结束时，俱乐部银行账户里几乎没有钱了。

sentences.en: Following this revelation,
